entries.scope: Wave 1 (8 live AI voice recorders & pendants)
entries.delta: Re-audited official vendor stores (plaud.ai, heypocket.com, omi.me, soundcore.com, switch-bot.com, ticnote.com). All 8 standard hardware MSRPs and Pro/Unlimited subscription rates matched baseline (seasonal Black Friday promos noted separately; VERIFIED_DATE baseline retained at 2026-11-22).

Published initial CC BY 4.0 24-month cost dataset across 32 active models, 1 service_shutdown device (Humane AI Pin), and 1 discontinued device (Limitless Pendant), plus versioned /data/v1/ CSV, JSON & Schema endpoints.
